entries.title: Exodus 1:1
segments: ¶Now these [are] the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.

entries.title: Exodus 1:2
segments: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

entries.title: Exodus 1:3
segments: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

entries.title: Exodus 1:4
segments: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

entries.title: Exodus 1:5
segments: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt [already]. {loins: Heb. thigh}

entries.title: Exodus 1:6
segments: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

entries.title: Exodus 1:7
segments: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.

entries.title: Exodus 1:8
segments: ¶Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

entries.title: Exodus 1:9
segments: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel [are] more and mightier than we:

entries.title: Exodus 1:10
segments: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and [so] get them up out of the land.

words.text: , and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out
against us, and [so] get them up

entries.title: Exodus 1:11
segments: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

entries.title: Exodus 1:12
segments: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel. {But...: Heb. And as they afflicted them, so they multiplied, etc}

words.text: . {But...: Heb. And as they afflicted them, so they multiplied, etc}

entries.title: Exodus 1:13
segments: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

entries.title: Exodus 1:14
segments: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, [was] with rigour.

words.text: , and in all manner of service

entries.title: Exodus 1:15
segments: ¶And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one [was] Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

entries.title: Exodus 1:16
segments: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see [them] upon the stools; if it [be] a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it [be] a daughter, then she shall live.

words.text: , When ye do the office of a midwife
him: but if it [be] a daughter

entries.title: Exodus 1:17
segments: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

entries.title: Exodus 1:18
segments: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

entries.title: Exodus 1:19
segments: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women [are] not as the Egyptian women; for they [are] lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.

entries.title: Exodus 1:20
segments: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

entries.title: Exodus 1:21
segments: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.

words.text: And it came to pass, because the midwives

entries.title: Exodus 1:22
segments: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
